title: Parse --flags into a dict
hints: *args arrives as a tuple of strings; loop over it and build a dict, assigning flags[key] = ... so repeats overwrite.
Check arg.startswith("--") first and raise ValueError otherwise; then work with arg[2:].
str.partition("=") returns (key, sep, value) and only splits once; sep is "" when there was no equals sign, which is your signal to store True instead of the (empty) value.
An empty key after stripping "--" is an error; replace "-" with "_" in the key before storing it.
